board: AG32VF303CCT6 L48, SRAM-only, control-first vendor witness harness (LED heartbeat rate oracle), af.exe images
vendor_reference: AG32-Docs tools/vendor_witness/gen_bram_modes.py: alta_bram9k instantiated directly per mode with explicit PORTA_OUTREG/PORTB_OUTREG/PORTA_WRITETHRU/PORTB_WRITETHRU parameters, proved against the vendor sim model (nominal + fault-injected), built through af.exe (tools/vendor_witness/bmd_build.py).
mechanism: bmd_mode_bits.py measured the config-bit encoding directly from the 39 vendor mode images (tools/vendor_parity/BRAM_MODE_BITS_20260925.md): CFG_SELOUT_A[0] set iff PORTA_OUTREG==1, CFG_SELOUT_B[0] set iff PORTB_OUTREG==1, CFG_SEL_WRITHU_A[0] set iff PORTA_WRITETHRU==1, CFG_SEL_WRITHU_B[0] set iff PORTB_WRITETHRU==1, in every one of the 39 images, no interaction with any other field. This is the same encoding agamemnon/engine/bram_emit.py EXPERIMENTAL_FIELDS already computes (unchanged); only the admission gate (AGAMEMNON_BRAM_EXPERIMENTAL_CONFIG requirement) moves.
consequence: Every vendor mode image exercising PORTA/B_OUTREG or PORTA/B_WRITETHRU passed at the exact heartbeat; none of the 39 modes regressed by setting either field. Unlike the narrow-write path this is a config-bit admission claim (bram_emit.emit is a pure function of the parameters; the BRAM port interface and pin usage are identical whether or not the internal output register or write-through mux is enabled, so no routing/packing/placement surface changes) -- promoted default-on in agamemnon/engine/bram_emit.py BOARD_PROVEN_CONFIG_FIELDS = {PORTA_OUTREG, PORTB_OUTREG, PORTA_WRITETHRU, PORTB_WRITETHRU}, still scoped to AGRV2KL48 BramTILE X13Y1..Y4. PACKEDMODE, DLYTIME and RSEN_DLY are NOT promoted (no board evidence for PACKEDMODE's data layout; DLYTIME/RSEN_DLY have no functional observable at 10 MHz in this harness) and stay behind AGAMEMNON_BRAM_EXPERIMENTAL_CONFIG.
open_side: bmd_rdw18_wt0/wt1 additionally require the WeA-tied-to-constant-1 packer admission (agrv2k.cc pack_bram_localize_const, unconditional_write_admitted); every OUTREG=1 open build needs this config-bit gate change plus the BRAM egress fix (work/bram-egress-20260925) that was previously blocking every full 18-lane read. Open-flow board results for these specific modes are tracked separately in tools/vendor_parity/BRAM_MODES_OPEN_20260925.md, not claimed here.
next_experiment: Board the open-flow builds of bmd_*_o1 and bmd_rdw18_wt0/wt1 under this default and record PASS/FAIL per mode in BRAM_MODES_OPEN_20260925.md.
